paper_metadata.title: A 85-dB Dynamic Range Multibit Delta–Sigma ADC for ADSL-CO Applications in 0.18-m CMOS
paper_metadata.abstract: A high-resolution multibit sigma–delta analog-todigital converter (ADC) implemented in a 0.18m CMOS technology is introduced. The circuit is targeted for an asymmetrical digital subscriber line (ADSL) central-office (CO) application [3]. An areaand power-efficient realization of a second-order single-loop 3-bit modulator with an oversampling ratio of 96 is presented. The modulator features an 85-dB dynamic range over a 300-kHz signal bandwidth. The measured power consumption of the ADC core is only 15 mW. An innovative biasing Fig. 1. ADSL band allocation (DUS, FDD). circuitry is introduced for the switched-capacitor integrators.
